title: HubSpot webhook handler processes the same event twice or in the wrong order
symptoms: Same objectId and subscriptionType delivered more than once
propertyChange events arrive older value last
Retries pile up when the handler takes more than five seconds
cause: HubSpot batches up to 100 events per request, treats any response slower than five seconds or any 4xx or 5xx as a failure, and retries up to ten times over 24 hours. It does not guarantee ordering, and duplicates can occur.
fix: Acknowledge with 200 immediately and process from a queue, dedupe on eventId, and order by occurredAt instead of arrival time.
apply: app.post('/hubspot', (req, res) => { res.sendStatus(200); for (const e of req.body) queue.add(String(e.eventId), e); });
affected: HubSpot Webhooks API v3 for legacy public apps, as of 2026-10
